name: MANAGE Internship Programme
benefit: > **Stipend:** - **For 3 months Internship Programme:** ₹ 10,000/- per month with free boarding and lodging.- **For 6 months Internship Programme:** ₹ 35,000/- per month. > **Duration:** - The internships are available for a duration of 3 months to 6 months.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should have completed/ongoing PhD or M.Sc in Extension Education/ Economics/ Sociology/ Psychology/ MSW/ Journalism/ Communication/ Environmental Science. - The applicant should have secured an OGPA of a minimum of 8 out of 10 (minimum 80%). - The applicant should have fluency in English. - The applicant should have good writing skills.
